release_notes:
Hide the redundant 'Online: Dr. Stephanie, Room 1, Room 2, ...' green status banner above the Ready Messages log when peers are online. The checkbox grid below the log already lists every online station -- duplicating the same names in a green status line above the log was just visual noise. The banner is now hidden via pack_forget whenever self.online_labels is non-empty and the network is running. It remains visible (and re-packs in its original position via before=self._ready_messages_header) for the not-yet-online states 'Not connected' and 'Waiting for other workstations...', because an empty checkbox grid in isolation is ambiguous (could mean 'no peers yet' or 'network broken') -- the banner disambiguates those cases.

Implementation: factored the show/hide logic into _set_status_banner_visible(visible), which checks winfo_ismapped() before calling pack/pack_forget so the operation is idempotent. The 'Ready Messages' header label was previously anonymous; it now gets stored on self._ready_messages_header so the status banner can be re-packed before it (preserving vertical order) when it needs to reappear after the network drops or the last peer disappears.
